samples.question: The picture shows a horizontal black rail with a row of evenly spaced black tick marks just below it; the distance between neighbouring ticks is one STEP. The black triangle under the ticks points at exactly one tick: that tick is the PIVOT. Standing on the rail are several columns, each built from square cells stacked one on top of another and outlined in black. Every column stands on exactly one tick and no column stands on the pivot tick. A column's WEIGHT is its number of cells. A column's ARM is the number of steps between the tick it stands on and the pivot tick. A column's MOMENT is its weight multiplied by its arm. Add the moments of all columns left of the pivot to get the left total, and the moments of all columns right of the pivot to get the right total. The cell colours and the pale horizontal guide rows are decorative and carry no information. Which side has the greater total moment? Answer left or right.
